rationale: Genome-wide Brie knockout screen in Cas9 mouse bone-marrow-derived dendritic cells stimulated with LPS and sorted into the top and bottom 10% of surface CD86 (two independent repeats). Columns are self-named and match the GSM titles. The term is low vs high bin, the same sign as the authors' MAGeCK lfc (treatment = low, control = high), so positive regulators of CD86 (Cd86 itself) are positive and negative regulators (March1, Cebpb) negative. The two repeats were sorted into both bins and so are paired, but a repeat term would leave 1 residual df; the libraries correlate about as weakly within as across repeats (Spearman 0.25-0.41), so the unpaired model (2 residual df) is used. The 986 BRDN guides are Brie non-targeting controls. The GEO file carries a UTF-8 byte-order mark in its first column name; prepare.R rewrites it without one (counts unchanged).
